$comment: Files that reach a database pool WITHOUT entering withTenantDb — checked by
This list is a RATCHET seeded from the state at audit PA-1 (2026-09-04). It
may only shrink. A new bypass that is not listed fails the build; a listed
file that no longer bypasses ALSO fails the build, so fixing a file forces
the entry to be deleted and the list can never rot.
class = by-design: there is genuinely no tenant to scope to (pre-tenant token
paths, identity, public/unauthenticated reads, person-scoped data, tables
with no org_id, cross-tenant platform administration). These stay.
class = debt: this SHOULD run inside withTenantDb. Tracked by PA-1R Phase 3.4.
Every one of these is a place where a single missing WHERE clause is a
cross-tenant leak with no second line of defence.
class = defect: a known bug being fixed in PA-1R Phase 2. Should reach zero

apps/web/src/app/api/webhooks/delivery-s.reason: FIXED (PA-1R 2.1). The finops write now runs inside withTenantDb on the app role, and the suppression on the app pool. The remaining system-pool use is ONE id→org lookup that opens that boundary — the dispatch's org is the only thing that can, and reading it is itself org-scoped. Adapter-verified id, single column, no write.

apps/web/src/app/api/webhooks/razorpay/r.reason: FIXED (PA-1R 2.2). The org-scoped half now runs inside withTenantDb, opened from the VERIFIED envelope's org. The remaining raw-pool reach is the deps handed in for signature verification only, which touches no database — the boundary cannot be opened before the signature is checked because no tenant-scoped handle exists until then.

apps/web/src/app/api/webhooks/sms-inboun.reason: FIXED (PA-1R 2.1). Writes `suppressions` on the app pool, which holds the DML. The table is deliberately not org-scoped — a person texting STOP tells the platform, not one club — so it carries no org_id and no RLS, and there is no tenant boundary to enter.

apps/web/src/app/demo/[token]/invite.ics.reason: Pre-tenant token path. The demo tables carry no org_id and no RLS — the person holding the link is a stranger with no tenant to be scoped to.

apps/web/src/app/dev/inbox/page.tsx.reason: Dev-only surface (notFound() outside development). Reads the OTP inbox, which is identity data with no tenant.

apps/web/src/app/inbox/page.tsx.reason: Person-scoped inbox spanning every org the viewer belongs to. The tenant here is the person, not one organization.

apps/web/src/app/readyz/route.ts.reason: Readiness probe: `select 1` only. Touches no tenant data, and must answer even when no session or org exists.

apps/web/src/app/schedule-demo/pick/page.reason: Public booking form, no session. Demo scheduling tables have no org_id.

apps/web/src/server/admin/access-log.ts.reason: Writes the audited breadcrumb for a platform-admin read. Cross-tenant by definition.

apps/web/src/server/admin/actions.ts.reason: Platform administration — cross-tenant by definition, read-only, gated by the platform:admin capability which RLS makes unforgeable.

apps/web/src/server/admin/demo-views.ts.reason: Platform demo desk. Demo tables have no org_id.

apps/web/src/server/admin/pass-actions.t.reason: Platform billing: the system pool answers slug to club only (an operator is a member of no club); the tier change itself runs inside withTenantDb for that club, on the app role, gated by platform:billing.

apps/web/src/server/admin/pass-views.ts.reason: Platform billing projections, cross-tenant by definition.

apps/web/src/server/auction/conduct-acti.reason: BURNED DOWN (PA-1R 3.4). The conduct screen's reads — including owner names and phone numbers — now run inside the withTenantDb boundary the rest of cockpitView already used. The remaining system-pool reads are publicSpectatorView, which is anonymous and visibility-gated: there is no session and therefore no tenant to scope to.

apps/web/src/server/auction/owner-action.reason: Owner-join landing and accept by token — pre-tenant, the same class as invites.

apps/web/src/server/auth/actions.ts.reason: Identity: people, sessions, otp_codes, passkeys. None carries org_id, none has RLS, and at login there is no tenant yet — this is the boundary that establishes one.

apps/web/src/server/competition/pass.ts.reason: Entitlement/tier lookup is a platform-billing fact that crosses orgs.

apps/web/src/server/competition/posters..reason: Public share-card rendering for visibility-gated competitions; no session exists.

apps/web/src/server/competition/public.t.reason: Public directory and season pages for unauthenticated visitors. Gated on visibility, not on tenancy.

apps/web/src/server/competition/resolve..reason: THE pre-tenant season resolver (PA-1R Phase 3.4, final readiness Phase 1). A console request knows only a slug, or spans every club a person belongs to, before any org can be named, and competitions/tournaments are org-only under RLS. Each function answers one pre-tenant question: membership-gated reads carry the org_members join in the same SQL statement; public reads return only what the public season page shows. Everything after resolution runs inside withTenantDb in the caller. This file replaced eight modules that had each done this themselves and then kept reading money, rosters and auctions on the bypass pool.

apps/web/src/server/competition/sports.t.reason: SP-1 Phase 1. The `sports` catalogue is global reference data — the same rows for every organization, no org_id column, no RLS policy — so there is no tenant to scope to and withTenantDb would set a GUC nothing reads. Reads only; the table is written by migrations.

apps/web/src/server/feature-settings.ts.reason: Platform-scope feature rows have no org_id; the org and auction layers below them do run inside a tenant boundary.

apps/web/src/server/financial-operations.reason: An owner's own receipts across every org they have ever bid in — person-scoped by paddle, cross-org by intent.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/actions.ts.reason: Public newsletter + demo request from strangers. No tenant exists.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/booking-ac.reason: Demo booking by HMAC-derived token, pre-tenant.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-avail.reason: Public demo availability; tables carry no org_id.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-booki.reason: Public demo booking; tables carry no org_id.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-desk..reason: Demo desk reads; tables carry no org_id.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-remin.reason: Scheduled reminder sweep over pre-tenant demo bookings.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-reten.reason: Retention purge over pre-tenant demo data.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-slots.reason: Slot computation over pre-tenant demo data.

apps/web/src/server/messaging/actions.ts.reason: notification_preferences is person-scoped with no org_id — deliberately a table a club can neither read nor write.

apps/web/src/server/orgs/actions.ts.reason: Invite preview and accept are THE documented pre-tenant token paths the system pool exists for: the reader is not yet a member, so no tenant can be established. NOTE: the accept path is separately tracked for transaction atomicity (PA-1 §9, PA-1R Phase 5.6).

apps/web/src/server/player/career.ts.reason: A player's career spans organizations by definition; scoping it to one would be wrong.

apps/web/src/server/player/profile.ts.reason: player_profiles is person-scoped with no org_id; the module self-scopes by personId.

apps/web/src/server/settlement/coordinat.reason: System sweep: enumerates orgs on the system pool, then enters withTenantDb per org to do the actual work.

apps/web/src/server/support/actions.ts.reason: FR-1. Public 'report a problem' form: a guest may file one, and problem_reports carries no org_id and no RLS (0064). Identity comes from the session, never the form.

apps/web/src/server/support/report-desk..reason: FR-1. The report desk's one write (status + operator stamp) on problem_reports — no org_id, no RLS. Called only behind platform:support.

apps/web/src/server/support/report-reten.reason: FR-1. Scheduled retention purge over problem_reports / problem_report_screenshots — no org_id, no RLS; behind FEEDBACK_JOB_SECRET. Launch Phase 5 adds the age purge of otp_codes / email_verifications rows and review_reports.reporter_ip (global, no org_id, no RLS) in the same job.

apps/web/src/server/admin/report-views.t.reason: FR-1. Platform report desk projection (read-only) over problem_reports — no org_id, cross-tenant by definition, gated by platform:support.

apps/web/src/server/admin/review-views.t.reason: FR-1. Platform review desk projection (read-only) over review_requests/reviews — gated by platform:support; platform reviews belong to no org.

apps/web/src/app/review/[token]/page.tsx.reason: FR-1. Pre-tenant token path, the same class as /demo/[token]: the link token is the whole principal, and review_requests/reviews carry no RLS.

apps/web/src/server/reviews/actions.ts.reason: FR-1. The public review form behind a link token — pre-tenant; review tables carry no RLS. The person is whoever the token's request names.

apps/web/src/server/reviews/desk.ts.reason: FR-1. Platform review desk writes (no-RLS review tables) plus ONE system-pool person lookup whose date-of-birth fallback reads tenant registrations — deliberately, so a platform operator's minor check cannot be blinded by RLS. Gated by platform:support.

apps/web/src/server/reviews/review-sweep.reason: FR-1. System sweep, the same class as settlement/coordination-sweep: a read-only candidate query across every org (closed auctions, finished seasons, organizer grants, paddles) on the system pool, then writes only to the no-RLS review tables. Behind FEEDBACK_JOB_SECRET.

apps/web/src/server/reviews/season.ts.reason: FR-1 Phase 4. Tournament reviews: the public season page's read (visibility-gated on the system pool, like competition/public.ts), the participant lookup the sweep and the club's Ask button share (registrations and paddles across one season, system pool), and writes only to review_requests / reviews / review_reports, which carry no RLS.

apps/web/src/server/reviews/season-actio.reason: FR-1 Phase 4. Seasons resolve through competition/resolve (the one pre-tenant reader); the competition.manage check runs inside withTenantDb. What remains on the system pool is the review counts over review_requests/reviews, which carry no org_id RLS (0065, 0070) — no tenant to scope to.

apps/web/src/server/reviews/voices.ts.reason: FR-1 Phase 5. The landing page's quotes: published, author-permitted PLATFORM reviews, read by an unauthenticated visitor. reviews carries no RLS and a platform review belongs to no org, so there is no tenant to scope to.

apps/web/src/server/admin/moderation-vie.reason: 0072. Platform moderation desk projection (read-only): every public season and every held one, across all clubs — cross-tenant by definition, gated by platform:moderation.

apps/web/src/server/admin/moderation-act.reason: 0072. The system pool answers one read — slug to club, which a platform operator (a member of no club) cannot ask otherwise. The hold itself is written inside withTenantDb for that club, on the app role.

apps/web/src/server/admin/live-watch.ts.reason: Platform administration live board and auction watch — cross-tenant by definition, read-only, gated by platform:admin; same shape as admin/actions.ts.

apps/web/src/server/roles/roles.ts.reason: Which roles a person holds spans every club they touch (organizer here, team owner there, player elsewhere), so it cannot be scoped to one org. Every system-pool query is self-scoped to the session's personId (owner invites accepted_by, paddle grants person_id, registrations/player_profiles person_id), the career.ts posture. It decides what the shell OFFERS, never what a surface ALLOWS.

apps/web/src/server/messaging/outbox.ts.reason: Personal-message queue (0079): message_outbox is a platform table keyed by person — no org_id arm, no RLS, like otp_codes. enqueue writes rendered mail at the moment (sale, appointment); the drain claims due rows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED across every org and resolves each person's verified email and consent at send time. Drain reachable only from the moment's own action (after()) and /api/jobs/messages behind FEEDBACK_JOB_SECRET.

apps/web/src/server/competition/appointm.reason: Reads message_outbox dedupe keys (platform queue, no RLS) to tell which appointments were already announced; every season read stays inside the caller's withTenantDb. Behind team.manage (appointment-actions.ts).
